data.name: Block Crime
data.detailed_description:
A CITY THAT LIVES

Palms, neon, and crime. A city inspired by the atmosphere of Miami and Los Angeles. Districts, gangs, random events, and a constant power struggle.

 

CHOOSE YOUR SIDE

Cop or criminal — it’s up to you. Patrol the streets, conduct raids and arrests, or join a gang, take part in shootouts, commit robberies, or control districts.

 

GANG WARS & PvP

Fight for influence in the city. Take part in massive shootouts, capture territories, level up your gang, and show who’s boss.

 

CHASES & ACTION

Sirens, drifting, crashes, and adrenaline. Dynamic GTA gameplay with a Minecraft visual style. Escape the police or, on the contrary, stage large-scale pursuits with roadblocks.

 

FLAWLESS STYLE

Create your own character. A wide selection of skins, accessories, a huge vehicle fleet — stand out and improve, going from a petty thug to a legend of Los Palms.

 

Block Crime is not just a game. It’s your story in a world where every day is a new challenge and a risk... to lose everything!

data.short_description: Imagine GTA, but in a blocky style with a living online RP world. Block Crime is a crime simulator where you choose your role: police officer, gangster, or ordinary worker. Take over districts, participate in gang wars, create businesses, and become the boss of Los Palms city!
